messages:
jules_sdr: FYI — need a short, customer-friendly blurb for ACME on our incident response & breach notification timelines. They asked for exact windows to put in the questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ) and an explainer we can paste into the SOW. cc @maya_sec @samir_se

maya_sec: Quick summary we use in presales: we notify affected customers as soon as we have confirmed an incident that impacts their data; initial notification target is within 24 hours of confirmation, an interim update with scope + mitigations within 72 hours, and a post-incident report within 30 days. For regulatory needs we will coordinate timelines by region.

samir_se: For CAIQ/SIG mapping: point the buyer at our completed CAIQ spreadsheet (internal link) and call out these control families: IR-1, IR-2, IR-4 (detection, analysis, communications). We keep evidence in the compliance bucket: incident playbook, tabletop notes, and SOC2 report.

rachel_legal: Small but important edit: wording should say "within 24 hours of confirmation" not "detection" — we must avoid implying instantaneous detection. Also add: "notifications are subject to applicable law and the terms of our agreement."

anna_sales_eng: For POC specifics: if the POC includes customer data or is run in a dedicated environment, we treat it exactly like production for IR purposes. If it's a hosted sandbox with synthetic data, we still notify but scope is limited. If ACME wants faster SLA, we can offer a contractual notif window in Dedicated/Private deals (ops review required).

incident-bot: IR playbook updated: https://internal.redwood/ir-playbook (contains notif templates, contact matrix, and data classification matrix).

jules_sdr: Can someone give me a 3-line snippet I can paste into the questionnaire and email? Keep it non-legal but precise.

maya_sec: Here you go — paste-friendly snippet (use for SIG/CAIQ "IR" fields and SOW):
```
Redwood Inference incident response: We notify affected customers within 24 hours of confirming a security incident impacting their data. We provide an interim status update within 72 hours and a full post-incident report within 30 days. Notifications and timelines are handled in accordance with applicable law and contract terms; we will coordinate with customer security teams and designated contacts.
Contact: security@redwood.ai | IR escalation: +1-555-555-0202
```

samir_se: Also add a short CAIQ pointer you can paste: "See our CAIQ v4 answers (internal) for control evidence: IR policies, tabletop summaries, SOC2 report, and forensic process."

jules_sdr: perfect — I'll drop that into the buyer questionnaire and SOW draft. Thanks all! :thumbsup:

anna_sales_eng: LMK if ACME asks for contractual notif windows, I can run numbers with finance/ops.

rachel_legal: I'll prepare the standard contract clause language in case they push for a hard SLA.

jules_sdr: nice — closing the loop.
